digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot startup composition and per-operation config binding
propositions: MCP and review-bot must capture static deployment/startup config once at service startup and compose a fresh OperationSnapshot for each operation/request
Inbound MCP bearer tokens and OAuth/JWKS material must remain request-scoped transient context and never enter startup config, operation snapshots, logs, caches, or schemas
Review-bot must validate decision-bearing Gerrit/GitHub auth before accepting a job/webhook and never fall back to alternative principals when auth is missing, conflicting, or revoked
Static binding changes (env vars, files) only rebind after process restart/redeploy; native SDK-owned refreshable capabilities may refresh in-process
Partial or rejected Langfuse/OTLP telemetry credentials must fail open (disable telemetry) without changing the underlying operation result; security/load-bearing auth must fail closed
Per-operation OperationSnapshot composition proves startup identity is stable across ambient mutation while operation-scoped non-secret config is freshly composed each request
